items.title: 5 Stocks in Big Food’s Bargain Bin
items.summary: The company, known for its jams and peanut butter, is making a killing on Uncrustables, a highly processed, frozen version of the humble PB&J. Annual sales recently topped $1 billion and now account for more than 10% of Smucker’s $8.9 billion in annual revenue.  Investors are eating up Uncrustables, too.  Wall Street expects Smucker’s earnings to rise 10% in 2027.
